notes.title: 🔥 New Game Mode: SURVIVAL MODE — Launching with the Demo on May 26
notes.notes:
Dead Oil is about to get even harsher.

Survival Mode drops May 26 alongside the public demo — and it’s built to break your habits.

🛢️ Drilling resets every wave
No more building long-term comfort. Each wave wipes the map clean. You start fresh, drill fast, and adapt to survive.

🛒 The shop rerolls every wave
No predictable upgrade paths. The shop offers a new set of randomized gear every round. You deal with what you get — or die trying.

Every run is unpredictable. Every decision matters.
You won’t get the same setup twice. You’ll have to improvise, experiment, and claw your way forward.

Survival Mode launches with the Dead Oil demo on May 26.
Be ready — this mode doesn’t forgive mistakes.

notes.title: 🔥Dead Oil Demo Launches May 26 - Drive, Drill, Survive
notes.notes:
Hey scavengers, Alon here – and the wait is over!

Watch the trailer, load up your rig, and dive into the wasteland:
[previewyoutube=GkiRY2zKlRI;full][/previewyoutube]

Dead Oil is a roguelite survival driller set in a gritty, Mad Max-inspired desert. Drive, drill, and defend your rig as you scavenge for resources and survive waves of ruthless raiders. Every run challenges you to adapt, upgrade, and outlast.

You’ll start with a basic rig, a single drill, and not much else. During the day, fight off enemy assaults from three deadly factions. At night, park your truck and drill for precious oil while making tense decisions about what to upgrade next—your firepower, your drilling tech, or your own lifeforce.

The demo features:

A complete gameplay loop with both combat and drilling phases

5 distinct enemy types

Dozens of upgrades for your rig, weapons, and gadgets

Randomized relics to shift your strategy

A brutal and stylish post-apocalyptic atmosphere

This is just the beginning.

I am building something ambitious here, tight progression, fast-paced gameplay, and meaningful roguelite systems. And this demo is your first step into the wasteland.

Huge thank you to everyone who’s wishlisted, tested, and shared feedback. You’ve helped shape the game massively already.

If you enjoy the demo, we’d love your help:
→ Tell a friend
→ Share a screenshot
→ Tell your favorite YouTuber to check out the demo – every bit of coverage helps Dead Oil

Let’s see how long you can survive when the oil runs dry.

Alon
Solo dev behind Dead Oil
